name: Miloš Petrović
bio:
Miloš Petrović's journey into motorsport was almost accidental. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer in Belgrade, he found himself drawn to the precision and high stakes of racing after volunteering at a local rally event. That experience sparked a passion for quality assurance that led him to pursue specialized certifications in non-destructive testing and advanced materials analysis.

Before joining Prema Junior, Miloš honed his skills inspecting aircraft components for a small aviation firm. He brings that same meticulous attention to detail to his current role, believing that even the smallest imperfection can have catastrophic consequences on the track. Miloš emphasizes proactive problem-solving and continuous improvement, fostering a culture of rigorous self-assessment within the quality control team. His commitment to excellence makes him a vital asset to the team's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Miloš is a stocky man with a serious demeanor and a slight paunch.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn slide rule.
Insists on using metric measurements exclusively.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
